goal.hit.text: Target met. I'd applaud, but wings.
{target} words. Target met. I've noted it in ink.
Target met. That was me ruffling. It's subtle.
Target met. I had nothing to do with it.

goal.progress.text: {pct}% of the target. I'm keeping count. Quietly.
{pct}% there. I've stopped pretending not to count.
{pct}%. Ravens can count. It's our one party trick.

snapshot.saved.text: Snapshot saved. Even I couldn't lose that one.
Snapshot saved. Safer than anything in my nest.
Saved. Filed, dated, and out of my reach.

app.failed.text: Something failed. Not me, for once. Worth a look.
That didn't go through. Have a look. I'll hold the pencil.
Something went wrong just now. I'd fix it, but I'm a bird.

session.long.text: {minutes} minutes. I've been on this perch for all of them.
A long session. My pencil needs sharpening. Not your problem.
{minutes} minutes. Ravens keep long watches. I'm keeping this one.
Past midnight. Ravens keep these hours anyway.

stuck.offer.text: Synonyms are a right-click away. I'd fetch them, but beak.
Click me if you want to talk. I'm better company than I look.
I can keep quiet. I'm good at it. Or click me to talk.

pause.long.text: I'll be here, pretending not to watch.
I'm preening. This could take a while. My end, not yours.
Quiet. Ravens are good at quiet. Mostly.
{remaining} words to the target. They're not going anywhere. Neither am I.

writer.returning.text: The manuscript didn't move. I checked.
“{doc}” is as you left it. I sat on it. Figuratively.
{words} words, all present. I counted twice. Ravens do that.

findings.spell.text: Spelling: one word marked. I can show you. | Spelling: {count} words marked. I can show you.

One word the dictionary doesn't know. Neither do I, and I've read the dictionary. Want to see it? | {count} words the dictionary doesn't know. Neither do I, and I've read the dictionary. Want to see them?
One word marked. Could be a name. Shall I point it out? | {count} words marked. Could be names. Shall I point them out?

findings.repetition.text: “{lemma}” comes up {lemmaCount} times. Ravens notice shiny things. Shall I show you?
“{lemma}”: {lemmaCount} times. Maybe on purpose. I only count.
Repeated words: one mark. I can show you. | Repeated words: {count} marks. I can show you.

One rhyme, probably by chance. Shall I point it out? | {count} rhymes, probably by chance. Shall I point them out?

offer.snapshot.text: A long run of revising and no snapshot. I can file one. Filing is a raven talent.
About {minutes} minutes of rework, nothing saved. Want a snapshot? I'll keep it out of my nest.
Shall I keep a snapshot? A raven likes a record.

offer.bible.text: {title}, {count} times now. Shall I look it up? I'm good at finding things.
{title} again. Ravens remember names. Shall I search the project for it?
That name keeps returning. Shall I go and fetch it?
